meaning:
δι-αρπάζω
[in LXX for בָּזַז, גָּזַל, שָׁסַס, etc. ;]
to plunder: Mat.12:29, Mrk.3:27.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.
But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.
